name: Apart Sonja Mayrhofen
beschreibung: The Apart Sonja Mayrhofen is located in Mayrhofen and offers comfortable holiday apartments. The apartments feature a fully equipped kitchen, a dining area, and a balcony. Complimentary Wi-Fi and a ski cellar are provided. Dedicated parking is available right at the property. The town center and the Penkenbahn cable car can be reached on foot in about ten minutes. The accommodation is well suited for independent stays for couples and small families. Guests can enjoy scenic hikes in summer and easy access to skiing in winter directly from the property.
